spanish: Y si alma cuando pecare, e hiciere una de todos los mandamientos de Jehová que no se harán, y no conoció, y *será* culpado, y llevará su iniquidad.
grammarChanges: h03005017015: 'culpado' was a bare participle with no finite verb, losing the qal sequential perfect's finite predication; supplied the copula *será* (future indicative, matching the apodosis tense already used for alzará/llevará) to restore a finite predicate without changing the lexical choice.

h03005017014: 'conociere' (future subjunctive) matched the hypothetical mood of pecare/hiciere, but the Hebrew is a plain qal perfect (completed, not sequential), not part of that hypothetical chain; changed to the preterite indicative 'conoció' to restore the distinct stem force, keeping the same verb root (conocer) and polarity.

h03005017016: 'alzará' narrowed the qal sequential perfect of lift/carry/bear/take to only 'raise'; replaced with 'llevará', the same licensed bear/carry sense of the same lemma, keeping the identical future-indicative tense.
h03005017007-008: corrected 'desde todos mandamientos' to 'de todos los mandamientos' — wrong preposition and a missing article, pure Spanish grammar, no change to participants or sense.
readerNote: Supplied the copula *será* with culpado to restore the finite qal predicate that the bare participle had dropped.
